app_title: Network Traffic Analysis and Anomaly Detection System
app_subtitle: Topology visualization, anomaly detection, and path analysis workbench
dashboard_subtitle: A focused entry point from data import to topology analysis
topology_subtitle: Inspect full graphs, subgraphs, and large-graph rendering results
traffic_subtitle: Analyze key flows by total traffic, HTTPS, or outgoing ratio
path_subtitle: Compare min-congestion, min-hop, and min-risk paths
anomaly_subtitle: Detect port scans, DDoS targets, and star structures
rule_subtitle: Express business-side detection rules with combined conditions
subgraph_subtitle: Generate local topology around a selected IP address
results_summary_desc: Logs, tables, and path details automatically switch to the most suitable view when a task completes.
settings_overview_desc: Manage appearance, language, and runtime behavior so the analysis workspace stays stable, clear, and easy to use.
settings_theme_desc: Switch between light, dark, or system theme manually.
settings_runtime_desc: Adjust the thread count used by backend analysis tasks.
dashboard_body: Start from PCAP or CSV data, generate the topology automatically, run detection tasks, and export the results to a unified results center.
dashboard_metric_topology_desc: Generate the full topology automatically and support large-graph rendering strategies.
dashboard_metric_detection_desc: Review port scan, DDoS, and star-structure detection in one place.
dashboard_metric_export_desc: Export CSV, JSON, and HTML artifacts for review and presentation.
dashboard_command_desc: After selecting a data file, the system generates the full topology and enables analysis tools.
quick_topology_desc: Inspect the generated network topology and tune large-graph rendering.
quick_anomaly_desc: Run port scan, DDoS, and star-structure detection in one place.
quick_results_desc: Review run logs, table output, and path details.
render_settings_desc: Choose vis-network or Sigma by graph scale and enable load-shedding for huge graphs.
settings_language_desc: Language changes update the interface immediately.
settings_help_desc: Open the user manual or version information.

empty_star_content: This star-structure search did not find center nodes matching the threshold. Check the run log, or lower the leaf-node threshold before retrying.
empty_custom_rule_content: This custom rule detection did not find violation records. Check the run log, or adjust the target IP, IP range, protocol, port, and rule conditions before retrying.
